info.name: Printroom API (Instagram system design)
info.description:
End-to-end contract tests for the Spring Boot API.

Run the folders in order: each run registers fresh users (alice, bob, carol, dave), so it is re-runnable.
Select the **Local (LocalStack)** or **Prod (AWS)** environment for `baseUrl`.

The S3 upload step sends `fixtures/sample.jpg`; when running with newman pass `--working-dir postman`.

item.name: Alice's feed has fan-out AND celebrity posts

request.description: Bob's post arrives via fan-out-on-write (async SQS worker -> Redis). Carol is a celebrity, so her post is merged in at read time.

const done = (function(json) { return json.items && json.items.some(p => p.postId === pm.collectionVariables.get("bobPostId")); })(pm.response.json());
pm.test("Newest first", () => { const ts = pm.response.json().items.map(p => p.publishedAt); pm.expect(ts).to.eql([...ts].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });
